title: Completed strict henselization is flat over the base
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal n, let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field, and let T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r be its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical ring map A\to T is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: By [lem-sc-strict-henselization-mod-power-free], T is the n-adic completion of the free A-module F=\bigoplus_{x\in X}A, the identification being the inverse limit of the A/n^r-isomorphisms F/n^rF\cong A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r sending basis vectors to the images of X; under it the module action of \hat A=\varprojlim_r A/n^r on \hat F is the action through the ring map \hat A\to T obtained as the limit of A/n^r\to A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r. Since F is free, hence flat, and A is Noetherian, the completion-of-a-flat-module theorem [lem-weil-pbc-flat-module-completion-flat] makes T flat over \hat A, i.e. the ring map \hat A\to T is flat; the ring map A\to\hat A is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-completion-flat]. Their composite is the canonical map A\to T, so it is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-comp].
